messages:
sonya: prepping the 02:00 UTC change window. Plan: push api v2.1.0, runtime 6.0.2 with patch, console schema moves header_split -> string[] (breaking), and router behavior needs a flattening mode. tagging eng-runtime + infra.

deploy-bot: scheduled: api:v2.1.0 canary @02:05 UTC (5% for 10m). Rollback: `deploy rollback api --to v2.0.9`.

ben: note — our SDKs expect header_split as string in a few older clients. We should add a compatibility note in release notes and coordinate an SDK patch.

harry: runtime shim will temporarily normalize header arrays into single string keys (`join(',')`) for existing KV composition. Prefer to keep shim for 24h then flip.

elaine: router can be pinned to 3.4.3 which includes `header_passthrough=flatten` but it's not default. Recommend pin router and set config for flatten for this rollout.

ben: rollout matrix suggestion:
- api: redwood/api:v2.1.0
- runtime: redwood/runtime:6.0.2-patch (shim enabled)
- console: redwood/console:1.8.1-schemaC
- router: redwood/router:3.4.3 (flatten)
Keep router pinned until SDKs patched.

sonya: ok. Canary conditions: p95 <= 230ms, 5xx < 0.5%, kv_hit_rate >= 85%. If failing -> immediate rollback per playbook.

alert-bot: applying alerts for this deploy: `p95_api > 250ms` (5m), `5xx_rate > 1%` (1m), `kv_hit_rate < 80%` (2m). Auto-fallback: if `5xx_rate > 2%` for 2m -> trigger rollback and pin router to prior stable.

harry: deploy manifest snippet for deploy-bot:
```
services:
  api:
    image: redwood/api:v2.1.0
    rollout: canary
  runtime:
    image: redwood/runtime:6.0.2-patch
    env:
      - name: HEADER_NORMALIZE_SHIM
        value: "true"
  router:
    image: redwood/router:3.4.3
    config:
      header_passthrough: flatten
  console:
    image: redwood/console:1.8.1-schemaC
```

sonya: deploy-bot starting canary now at 02:05:00 UTC. Monitoring enabled.

alert-bot: canary metrics initial (2m): p95=190ms, 5xx=0.12%, kv_hit_rate=93%. No alerts.

ben: good sign. Hold for 10m then bump to 25%. Also drafting customer-facing blurb: "Console schema update: header_split is now an array. SDKs will be updated; server will provide temporary compatibility. Reach out: sdk@redwood.com." Any edits?

elaine: add note about expected short warm-up and brief kv miss increase ~3-8 minutes.

sonya: bumping to 25% at 02:16 UTC.

alert-bot: 25% snapshot (6m): p95=205ms, 5xx=0.18%, kv_hit_rate=89%. All good.

harry: plan a shim-off trial: after 30m at 25% flip HEADER_NORMALIZE_SHIM=false and monitor for 15m. If kv_hit_rate falls >7 points or p95 > +40ms rollback shim on.

ben: who will flip shim? harry on-call?

harry: yes I'll do it and monitor.

sonya: reminder: if anything looks off, deploy-bot can run `router pin 3.4.3` to ensure flattening remains.

harry: flipping shim at 02:48:30 UTC -> HEADER_NORMALIZE_SHIM=false. Observing.

alert-bot: post-flip metrics (10m): p95=215ms, 5xx=0.16%, kv_hit_rate=86%. Slight drop but within thresholds.

ben: kv hit-rate dipped 4 points then stabilized. Looks acceptable. We'll keep router pinned for the next 24h and set a follow-up to unpin after SDK patches land.

sonya: moving to 100% at 03:12 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 03:12:10 UTC. Deployed versions: api:v2.1.0, runtime:6.0.2-patch (shim off), console:1.8.1-schemaC, router:3.4.3 pinned.

sonya: thanks all. I'll publish the release notes draft to #customers in the morning and open a kanban card for SDKs. Leave router pinned for 24h. If anyone sees customer impact, escalate immediately. :tada:
